verdict.rationale: Moneybird has a public REST API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question, but the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The docs cover endpoints, MCP, a CLI and an llms.txt file, but none of them is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. llms.txt is LLM-oriented documentation, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
